mapper.sql: h.hotplace_id, h.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, h.linked_place_id, p.title AS linked_place_title, h.title, h.content, h.address, h.latitude, h.longitude, h.status, h.created_at, h.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM hotplaces h LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = h.user_id LEFT JOIN historical_places p ON p.place_id = h.linked_place_id WHERE h.hotplace_id = #{hotplaceId}
SELECT image_id, hotplace_id, image_url, original_name, saved_name, created_at FROM hotplace_images WHERE hotplace_id = #{hotplaceId} ORDER BY image_id
